4:It is deployed separately from the billing app, as its own function.

The Growth team signs off, and any Growth engineer can approve. Raise the change in **#growth-eng**.

Dana Okafor used to own the notifier and had to approve copy changes. That is out of date. The notifier moved to Growth on 2026-09-01, and Dana is now on Platform. The older ownership note is already marked superseded by the current one. The repo has no CODEOWNERS file, so this comes from the project memory and not from anything enforced in the repo.

When you edit the wording, keep these in mind:
- **Both files:** the receipt template lives in `services/notifier/templates/` as `<event>.mjml`. It needs a plain-text twin, `<event>.txt`, with the same snake_case variables. Update both.
- **Testing delivery:** the email sandbox silently drops anything not addressed to `@sink.acme.test`. It is also capped at 500 messages a day for the whole team.

I didn't find a `templates/` directory under `services/notifier` in this checkout. I haven't located the receipt template itself.
